qa_scope: 逐张原尺寸画面审查，复核人物衣着背景、左右手、动作方向、支点器械、解剖比例与组内机位。不以生成成功代替画面审查。静态图片不检验临床效果、实际负荷或肌肉发力。

groups.title: 单臂斜向抬举：徒手至轻哑铃
steps: s02 右手徒手对角线途中
s03 右前外上方终点，不超过肩高
groups.note: 本批不制作s01；返回可复用s02后回s01。

groups.title: 支撑单臂哑铃/壶铃划船
steps: s01 左手扶台、双足站稳，右手哑铃下垂
s02 右肘回拉、哑铃近躯干

groups.title: 固定锚点弹力带划船
steps: s01 坐位双手前伸持带
s02 双肘回拉、手近躯干

groups.title: 哑铃/壶铃地板卧推
steps: s01 仰卧屈膝、上臂轻触垫、腕在肘上
s02 双手推起、肩背臀留垫
groups.visibility_note: 侧前上方机位，近侧上臂与肘触垫明确；远侧肘由躯干自然遮挡，远侧前臂、腕与哑铃可见。

groups.title: 地雷杆斜向推举
steps: s01 站姿双手肩前握杠端
s02 双手沿固定支点弧线前上推

independent_review: 制作人员逐张审查；主代理按清单逐张原尺寸复核10张；打包后逐图比对源文件与ZIP内PNG的SHA256。

Use case: scientific-educational. Create exactly ONE independent photorealistic rehabilitation exercise photograph, frame 159 / step s02, the MIDWAY posture of an UNLOADED RIGHT-arm diagonal raise, not a montage.
Reference images 1–3 are identity, clothing and photographic style references ONLY. Same Chinese adult woman, identical facial identity and age, natural proportions, black ponytail, plain white short-sleeve T-shirt and charcoal full-length trousers; clean white trainers. Camera: nearly frontal, very slightly from her right, fixed full-body portrait framing including complete head, both hands and both shoes with margins. She stands upright facing forward, feet hip-width and parallel, pelvis and breastbone square forward, no trunk twist, no arching.
Action: it is her anatomical RIGHT hand (viewer LEFT arm in the frontal view). The motion starts with this right hand in front of the opposite LEFT thigh and will finish diagonally up and out to her RIGHT front at below shoulder height. Show only the MIDPOINT now: her right hand is in the space in front of the middle of her abdomen, at approximately upper-waist / lower-sternum height, moving away from the opposite left thigh toward her right front. Right arm reaches forward in a low diagonal, elbow nearly straight but relaxed, wrist straight, fingers relaxed and clearly anatomically correct. Right hand is EMPTY. Left arm hangs relaxed beside her left hip. Shoulders remain level and relaxed, head looks forward. This midpoint must be substantially lower and closer to the body midline than the final raised arm. No ghosted limbs, no motion trails, no weights, no extra objects.
